intermediate.name: Col de Saint Andrieu
intermediate.title: KOM Sprint (3) Col de Saint Andrieu (92.4 km)

story: Four riders broke away early, including Ethan Hayter and Koen Bouwman. Bouwman took the mountain points to claim the KOM jersey. Hayter briefly attacked for bonus seconds at the intermediate sprint. Late attack attempts by Wout van Aert, Tadej Pogacar and Alessandro Romele were neutralised. Matthew Brennan won the sprint, while Pogacar retained the leader’s jersey.
